contexts.text: They can pervert the thoughts... and substitute other things.
This he detracts from the Lord what is His, and substitutes himself. AC 1813:2.
To weigh = to substitute in place of the former.
The deceitful send Subjects, (who) are substituted. Explained.
So substitute others in their place (for punishment). SE 3416. SE 4277.
When he was inculpated, he substituted the innocent. SE 3465. Explained.
The reason Mohammeds are continually substituted in place of the other...

Whatever true or good was said by me... she substituted in place of it what is false or evil. (Thus) in place of Gehenna she substituted a bright white light, so that they might not know what I was saying.
They want to substitute other persons.
